name: flipcountdown
title: Flip Countdown Timer
description: A black page with a small spaced caption over four square number tiles: a glowing orange days box and three navy boxes for hours, minutes and seconds. The seconds tick down live and the layout ends in a Time's Up message.
use: A launch or event page needs a live countdown with a bold arcade-like numeric display.
avoid: The target is always the current year's end, and the orange and cyan glow and black page are fixed.
a11y: The numbers are plain spans with no live region, so screen readers never hear the ticking; the flip class has no reduced-motion guard. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide black stage with a small widely tracked NEW YEAR COUNTDOWN label. Below sit four rounded square tiles split by a thin line, the first filled orange-red with white digits, the rest dark navy with cyan digits and blue glowing rims. Small grey dots separate the tiles and tiny blue unit labels sit beneath each.
behaves: The seconds tile changes every second while days, hours and minutes hold steady. When the clock reaches zero the tiles are replaced by a red Time's Up banner.
customise: The target date is computed as the end of the current year and the label is fixed; tile colours, sizes and the flip class need source edits.
weight: light: One interval updating four numbers each second; no canvas or heavy work.
demo: Caption "NEW YEAR COUNTDOWN" showing 51 days, 04 hours, 14 minutes and a seconds tile ticking toward zero.
issues: The colon separators render as two small stacked blocks rather than a colon.
Digits update silently with no live region for assistive tech.
polishWhy: Neat neon tiles with a good glow, but the separators look like stray stacked dots.
